diagnosis.root_cause: Early-stage infeed starvation or jam at the starwheel likely caused by containers jamming or guide rails misalignment, leading to a sharp drop in filler speed.
recommended_actions: Inspect starwheel area for jammed or damaged containers.
Check conveyor chain and guide rails for wear or misalignment.
Verify upstream depalletizer operation to ensure it is running properly.
sources: conveyor_system.md#Error code E-402: Infeed starvation / jam

diagnosis.root_cause: Early-stage main drive bearing wear or lack of lubrication causing increased vibration.
recommended_actions: Inspect main drive bearings for wear or lubrication issues.
Check alignment of drive coupling.
Verify mounting bolts are tight.

diagnosis.root_cause: Early-stage product temperature rise likely due to chiller system issues such as low refrigerant, compressor trip, glycol pump failure, or fouled plate heat exchanger.
recommended_actions: Inspect chiller refrigerant levels and compressor status.
Check glycol pump operation and seals for leaks.
Examine plate heat exchanger for fouling or blockage.
Monitor temperature trend closely and prepare for potential E-214 error code if temperature continues to rise.
sources: chiller_system.md#Error code E-214: Product temperature high

action_plan.ticket_title: Urgent: Chiller System Issue Causing Product Temperature Rise on Line L1
maintenance_steps: Inspect chiller refrigerant levels and compressor status.
Check glycol pump operation and seals for leaks.
Examine plate heat exchanger for fouling or blockage.
Monitor temperature trend closely and prepare for potential E-214 error code if temperature continues to rise.
action_plan.planner_recommendation: Prioritize production recovery on Line L1 to fulfill orders SO-10053 and SO-10014 as soon as possible. Adjust schedules to minimize short shipments and communicate delays to customers.

diagnosis.root_cause: Early-stage CO2 pressure drop likely due to a leak at a CO2 line fitting or regulator diaphragm issue, as pressure is trending downward and approaching the low pressure threshold causing flat product.
recommended_actions: Check bulk CO2 tank level to ensure it is not running low.
Perform leak test on CO2 line fittings using soapy water; tighten or replace any leaking fittings.
If pressure continues to drift after tightening fittings, replace the regulator diaphragm.
sources: carbonation_co2.md#Error code E-118: CO2 pressure low

action_plan.ticket_title: Urgent Repair of CO2 Pressure Drop on Line L2 Affecting Order SO-10035
maintenance_steps: Check bulk CO2 tank level to ensure it is not running low.
Perform leak test on CO2 line fittings using soapy water; tighten or replace any leaking fittings.
If pressure continues to drift after tightening fittings, replace the regulator diaphragm using part CR-45.
action_plan.planner_recommendation: Prioritize production of order SO-10035 after repair to fulfill the shortfall of 403 cases as soon as possible.
